name: Fashion Island
summary: This outdoor shopping mall with water features has popular retailers, restaurants & a cinema.
description: Fashion Island is an iconic open-air shopping destination in Newport Beach featuring premier retailers, luxury boutiques, and a distinctive movie theater experience. The center offers upscale dining options, personal shopping services, and hosts seasonal events including holiday tree lighting ceremonies and photos with Santa. Guests enjoy an elevated outdoor shopping experience with amenities like gift cards, concierge service, and convenient access to Disneyland Resort tickets.
demographics: Fashion Island attracts affluent shoppers from Newport Beach and surrounding Orange County coastal communities, with a primary demographic of high-income households (median household income $150k+) consisting of professionals, families, and empty nesters aged 35-65. The trade area encompasses the upscale Newport Beach, Corona del Mar, Irvine, and Laguna Beach markets, known for luxury home ownership and discretionary spending power. Visitors are typically fashion-conscious consumers seeking premium brands, designer boutiques, and elevated dining experiences, with shopping patterns favoring quality over value and a preference for personalized services like the center's personal shopping program.
